verdict_summary: Mode collapse at the 1220-record canonical master is template-family-level (23.5% of records in loose semantic families, headline cells over cap on two independent instruments) and prior-art-exposure-level (novelty unverified 1220/1220; O-002/O-031 verified real prior art retained by 2-1), NOT subject- or lexical-level (SAM 7.1% and falling, max pairwise Jaccard 0.237 over all 743,590 pairs, 156 clusters max 1.1%). Freeze of Stage-1 generation is acceptable; more generators are NOT required and would worsen template-family growth. Freeze is bound to 4 selection-side remediation items (GATE-8 novelty triage priority 1-4, fingerprint back-mapping before mechanical slot caps, 127-record remand disposition, forced best-of-family adjudication) - all already owned by lanes queued at the w3 diversity audit, all before the Stage-2 200-cut. Zero fake citations (exhaustive extraction, all ~20 citation strings verified real and correctly attributed; Sea-thru DOI re-verified by live web check).
